stable.notes: Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Core setup bundles Node/npm and starts the server from the welcome window without Homebrew or a separate npm installation. Includes responsive branded task editing and protected drafts. Voice setup remains separate. Pairs with server 6.65.0. New users start with Cloud Puff, bundled for offline use; existing pet choices are preserved. Open in platform now shows actionable failures in Sessions; queued follow-ups show recorded hold reasons.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
